Go TUI on Bubble Tea v2 over the `tasks` tracker. It shells out to the `tasks` binary
and reads its JSON; it never opens `tasks/*.md`.

## Setup

Work in a worktree under .worktrees/ (`git worktree add`), then `just setup`: it
downloads the Go modules and points `core.hooksPath` at `.githooks`.

## Gates

    just gate

`just check` runs `just check-hygiene` (`tools/ops-check`, `tools/ops-docs check`, `tasks check`) and `just check-code` (`gofmt`, `go vet`, `staticcheck`); `just ci-check-hygiene` omits `tasks check` on hosted runners without private detached records.
`just test-one <args>` runs focused `go test` targets; `just test-fast` skips the real-binary integration test; `just test` runs `go test -count=1 -v ./...` (the integration test skips when `tasks` is not on `PATH`); `just test-full` (`TT_FORCE=1 just test`) forces the full suite locally.
Hook recipes (`just hook-pre-commit`, `just hook-pre-commit-docs`, `just hook-pre-push`, `just hook-pre-push-fast`) time mandatory hygiene only and invoke broad children separately (making hook durations after the split incomparable with earlier whole-hook series). Checkout-root .tt.toml policy remains enabled until remote CI activation on `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is verified.
`just docs` regenerates the identity and family regions of README.md and AGENTS.md
from identity.toml and tools/family.toml; edit those files, never the regions.
Rebuild from the main checkout after changes merge: `just install` replaces the
`tasks-tui` and `tui` on `PATH`, so never run it in a worktree.
Fixtures under internal/tasksctl/testdata/ are recaptured with `just capture <name> <tasks
args>`, which pipes live output through `tools/scrub-fixtures`; raw `tasks` output is never
committed.

## Layout

- `cmd/tasks-tui/` — flags, config, startup probe, program.
- internal/tasksctl/ — the only place `tasks` runs: `Runner`, typed calls, JSON types, `Error`, `CheckoutFor`.
- internal/identity/ — familiar's slot algorithm (remote key, pins, fnv1a32, hue table, tone).
- internal/launch/ — harness commands and the terminal spawn.
- internal/config/ — `~/.config/tasks-tui/config.toml`.
- internal/ui/ — the Bubble Tea model: app, views, the shared task form, overlays, styles, the column model (columns.go), the legend.
- internal/uitest/ — the synchronous UI driver the ui tests press keys through.
- internal/integration/ — the real-binary test: the TUI against `tasks` in a scratch project; skipped when `tasks` is not on `PATH`.

## Rules

- This repo adopts the tasks skill's process and workspace policy: the task's `process`
  field, not a generic Superpowers trigger, decides whether brainstorming runs.
- The JSON contract belongs to `tasks`; [docs/tasks-contract.md](docs/tasks-contract.md) records the part tasks-tui uses.
  Anything the TUI needs and cannot get is a task in the tasks project, never a workaround here.
- Views get data only through the commands they return: no `update` or `render` runs `tasks`; each call runs inside a
  `tea.Cmd` through `env.Client` (internal/tasksctl/), and its result comes back as a message. Every successful write
  is followed by a reload of the top view, never by patching rows in place (`TestStartRunsInCheckoutAndReloads`).
- The legend is generated from the keymap: `legendGroups` in internal/ui/keys.go renders each binding's help text, so a
  grouped binding without help text fails `TestEveryGroupedBindingHasHelp`.
- Column widths (internal/ui/columns.go and the tables in rows.go and projects.go), the Projects pane's ready cap
  (`paneReadyCap`) and the age at which an age dims (`ageStyle`) are fixed in code, not configurable; a request to make
  one configurable is filed as an idea.
- A missing required field is a decode error. Sparse task optional fields and empty collections may be omitted. Fail early with a typed error; no silent fallbacks.
- No `--agent` on `add`: a person files from the TUI, and an agent stamp would misattribute it.
